page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Catchword "E" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: adversis rebus, alias ætate ingravescen-te. Atq; earum rerum exemplum ex si-militudine capiebat incuntis ætatis, quod summi puerorum amores sæpe una cum prætexta, & toga deponeren-tur. Sin autem ad adolescentiam per-duxissent, dirimi tamen interdum contentione, vel uxoriæ conditionis vel commodi alicujus, quod idem adipis-ci uterq; non posset. Quod si qui longius in amicitia provecti essent, tamen sæpe labefactari, si in honoris contentionem incidissent. Pestem enim majorem nullam esse in amicitiis, quam in plerisq; pecuniæ cupiditatem, in optimis quibusq; honoris certamen, & gloriæ: ex quo inimicitias maximas sæpe inter amicissimos extitisse. Magna etiam diffidia, & plerunq; iusta nasci cum aliquid ab amicis, qd[?] rectum non esset, postularetur, ut aurlibidinis[?] ministri, aut adiutores essent ad iniuriam. page.notes: Running head "ANALYSIS." and page number "49" are printed at the top. Catchword "E" is printed at the lower right. Long s is printed as an f-like form throughout; it is transcribed as plain s (e.g. "adversis", "sæpe", "esset"). "qd[?]": the abbreviation for quod is printed as a q with a flourish; the exact form is uncertain. "aurlibidinis[?]": the word at the line end is hard to separate; the letters are uncertain. "longius": no hyphen is visible at the line end, so the word is written whole. "ingravescen-te", "adipis-ci", "per-duxissent", "con-tentione", "deponeren-tur" and similar line-end breaks keep their printed hyphens. The page is one continuous paragraph that continues from the previous page and runs on into the next; no paragraph break is printed.
